title: APM / JVM
description: jvm.memory.used·jvm.thread.count는 UpDownCounter라 sum 테이블 적재 — 누적값=현재 수준이므로 delta 없이 플롯

targets.rawSql: SELECT t, ServiceName, sum(v) AS heap_used FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS t, ServiceName, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY t, ServiceName, series ) GROUP BY t, ServiceName ORDER BY t

SELECT t, ServiceName, sum(v) AS threads FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS t, ServiceName, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'jvm.thread.count' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY t, ServiceName, series ) GROUP BY t, ServiceName ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS t, ServiceName, avg(Value) AS cpu FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY t, ServiceName ORDER BY t

SELECT t, gc, sum(delta) AS collections FROM ( SELECT t, gc, greatest(0, cnt - lagInFrame(cnt, 1, cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY t)) AS delta FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS t, Attributes['jvm.gc.name'] AS gc, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Count) AS cnt FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'jvm.gc.duration' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY t, gc, series ) ) GROUP BY t, gc ORDER BY t

SELECT t, ServiceName, sum(v) AS classes FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS t, ServiceName, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'jvm.class.count' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY t, ServiceName, series ) GROUP BY t, ServiceName ORDER BY t

panels.title: 평균 GC 소요 시간 (jvm.gc.duration, cumulative delta)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t, gc, sum(dSum) / nullIf(sum(dCnt), 0) AS avg_gc FROM ( SELECT t, gc, greatest(0, cnt - lagInFrame(cnt, 1, cnt) OVER w) AS dCnt, greatest(0, s - lagInFrame(s, 1, s) OVER w) AS dSum FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS t, Attributes['jvm.gc.name'] AS gc, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Count) AS cnt, max(Sum) AS s FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'jvm.gc.duration' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY t, gc, series ) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY t) ) GROUP BY t, gc ORDER BY t
